notes: 44 of 51 episodes succeeded, counting every episode of the session (all controller versions, all bag positions, failures included). The final controller (right or left hand punch, feet fixed, COM feedback) succeeded in 20 of 20 seeds at the practice bag 0.38,-0.15,1 with 34-39 cm swing and a tilt of at most 4 degrees. The 7 failures were all at off-practice bags or in tuning runs: bags at x >= 0.45 were often out of reach and swung under 20 cm, and one tuning run with a 0.05 m forward COM shift made the robot fall at the practice bag.
